### Letterkenny, County Donegal, Ireland

|-------|-------------------|

| **Community** | The annual Letterkenny Food Festival was held last weekend, featuring local produce and craft stalls. |
| **Infrastructure** | Work began on upgrading the Letterkenny railway station to improve connectivity with Dublin. |
| **Culture** | The Letterkenny Arts Centre hosted a touring performance of a contemporary Irish play. |
| **Environment** | Local authorities launched a tree‑planting initiative along the River Swilly to enhance green spaces. |
